Selected design:
- silhouette: balanced bell silhouette with a softly flared stable base and integrated head
- crown: continuous integrated ceramic dome
- opening: exactly one mineral-red layered reveal created by two overlapping nested shell masses at the center; not two openings
- pose: both rounded arms softly embracing the center reveal
- expression: gently amused, communicated only by the calm eyes, with no mouth
- exterior material: balanced warm medium-grey stoneware, clearly grey rather than brown
- characteristic color: deep mineral red #7D2821
Family invariants:
- exactly one complete isolated figure with a stable continuous ceramic base
- tactile fine stoneware exterior with matte-to-satin glaze and subtle handmade microtexture

- exactly one dominant architecturally intentional opening created by the nested shell overlap and no other supporting reveal
- exactly two calm half-lidded inset eyes with ceramic eyelids, dark pupils, mineral-red iris accents, and tiny catchlights
- exactly two curved tubular ceramic arms ending in perfectly smooth seamless rounded tips with no hand anatomy, softly embracing the opening
- no conventional legs, knees, feet, toes, shoes, or visible human anatomy

- exactly one compact seed mark on the lower body containing exactly six circular apertures: four larger circular apertures at the four corners of a compact rectangle plus two smaller apertures centered vertically between them; nowhere else has dots or holes
- clean intact ceramic with smooth deliberately finished edges
- visibly honor the broad bell base, integrated dome, nested shell overlap, center reveal, and embracing arms
Scene: warm minimalist plaster alcove studio with a matte limestone floor.
